chrome-devtools.description: Chrome DevTools MCP — gives AI agents direct browser control for monitoring research platforms

study-monitor.description: Use Chrome DevTools to monitor research study platforms for new high-paying opportunities
instructions: 1. Navigate to the study platform (respondent.io, userinterviews.com, etc.)
2. Wait for the page to fully load and study cards to render
3. Use DOM inspection to extract study titles, pay amounts, and durations
4. Compare against known studies in the local SQLite database
5. Calculate effective hourly rate for each study
6. Flag any study paying above $50/hr effective rate as HIGH PRIORITY
8. Return structured data about new studies found
